description: This file defines metrics and functions related to authorization configuration reloads in the Kubernetes API server, including counters, gauges, and hash-based identification of configurations.

methods.name: RegisterMetrics
methods.description: Registers metrics for tracking authorization config reloads, ensuring registration occurs only once.

methods.name: ResetMetricsForTest
methods.description: Resets the counters and gauges for testing purposes.

methods.name: RecordAuthorizationConfigAutomaticReloadFailure
methods.description: Records a failed automatic reload attempt for a given API server ID.

methods.name: RecordAuthorizationConfigAutomaticReloadSuccess
methods.description: Records a successful automatic reload and updates the last config info.

methods.name: RecordAuthorizationConfigLastConfigInfo
methods.description: Stores hash information about the last applied authorization configuration.

methods.name: getHash
methods.description: Generates a SHA256 hash string for given data, using a pool of hash objects for efficiency.
